name: Leather Embroidered Slide Sandals
description: These slide sandals in white are made with genuine leather and feature embroidered flowers on the wide-strap uppers, cut-out details, open square toes and very low block heels. Pair them with sun hats and lightweight dresses during the warmer months.

name: Toe-Ring Strappy Heels
description: Simple yet elegant, these minimalist heeled sandals are designed for both comfort and style. Featuring a strappy design that is elevated by metallic toe-ring details, this pair in rich maroon are versatile and striking at the same time.

name: Ellory Mesh Thong Slingback Sandals
description: These Ellory thong sandals in red feature a pared-back design, breathable mesh panels, elasticised slingback straps, open toes and flat soles. They are perfect for adding a bold pop of colour that will liven up your casual off-duty looks.

name: Mesh Contrast-Trim Chunky Sneakers
description: The classic white sneaker gets a trendy update with these mesh chunky sneakers. Featuring a soothing colour palette of whites and greys, this distinctive pair -- with mesh panels and contrast trims -- stands out while being versatile enough to pair well with an array of looks.

name: Imani Polka-Dot Slingback Flats
description: These Imani Mary Jane slingback flats in dark brown feature a playful polka-dotted finish, adjustable straps across the insteps, polished silver buckles, covered round toes, elasticised slingback straps and comfortable flat soles. Versatile yet distinctive, they will add an eye-catching element to relaxed warm-weather outfits.

name: Kaia Patent Slingback Pumps
description: These Kaia slingback pumps in chalk feature a patent finish, sharp pointed toes, adjustable buckled slingback straps and mid stiletto heels. A wardrobe classic, they are versatile, understated and polished -- wear them with tailored separates or dresses.

name: Kyra Embroidered-Mesh Stiletto Pumps
description: These Kyra pumps in white are made with mesh and feature embroidered flower details, intricate beaded embellishments, sleek pointed toes and elegant flared heels. Perfect for a bridal look, they will also work well for any special-occasion ensemble.

name: Danni Patent Slingback Pumps
description: These Danni slingback pumps in blush feature a glossy patent finish, rounded square toes, chunky block heels and adjustable slingback straps. Wear them with long fluid dresses to keep your evening look effortlessly elegant and comfortable.

name: Tweed Bow Ballet Pumps
description: These ballet pumps feature a tweed finish, dainty bow details, chunky block heels, and softly rounded almond toes. Let them bring stylish definition to relaxed jersey pieces and well-worn denim.

name: Brantley Bow Slingback Pumps
description: These Brantley slingback pumps in pink feature pointed toes, stiletto heels, dainty bow details and elasticised slingback straps. Pair them with feminine dresses for nights out. This product contains recycled material.

name: Pointed Crystal-Heel Slingback Pumps
description: These slingback pumps in black are made with satin and feature pointed toes, slingback straps and visually striking sculptural heels. Pair them with sharp blazers and trousers for a polished, boardroom-ready look.

name: Lace & Satin Slingback Pumps
description: These slingback pumps in dark blue are made with lace and satin. They feature pointed toes, stiletto heels and adjustable slingback straps. Let them add a touch of refined femininity to relaxed tailored looks for work.

name: Meja Floral-Crochet Slingback Pumps
description: White shoes are a must-have for summer -- these Meja slingback pumps are definitely a worthy addition to your collection. Featuring a lovely floral pattern, these polished pointed-toe shoes stand on low cylindrical block heels. They can be dressed up or down with ease.

name: Back-Bow Slingback Pumps
description: These slingback pumps in burgundy feature covered pointed toes, slender stiletto heels, slim slingback straps and dainty bows at the back. Wear them to complete refined silhouettes for date nights or evening events.

name: Patent Crystal Slingback Pumps
description: These slingback pumps in lilac feature a glossy patent finish, pointed toes, slender stiletto heels, elasticised slingback straps and crystal embellishments. Use them to introduce soft colour and sparkle to special-occasion looks.

name: Marie Checkered Pearl Slingback Pumps - Multi
description: These Marie slingback pumps feature a checkered finish, slanted straps, pearl embellishments, covered pointed toes, chunky block heels and elasticised slingback straps. Wear them to add an eye-catching element to your weekend looks.

name: Marie Checkered Pearl Slingback Pumps - Cream
description: Same Marie slingback pumps model as above (checkered finish, pearl embellishments, covered pointed toes, chunky block heels, elasticised slingback straps) in the Cream colourway.

name: Marie Checkered Pearl Slingback Pumps - Black
description: Same Marie slingback pumps model as above (checkered finish, pearl embellishments, covered pointed toes, chunky block heels, elasticised slingback straps) in a black checkered colourway.

name: Raffia Sculptural-Heel Slingback Pumps
description: These slingback pumps in beige feature woven raffia uppers, contrast trims, adjustable buckled straps, sculptural heels, covered pointed toes and elasticised slingback straps. Designed for casual ease, they will add playful tactility to your warm-weather looks.

name: Patent Crossover Pointed Pumps
description: These pumps in black feature a glossy patent finish, slim crossover straps, covered pointed toes and slender stiletto heels. A wardrobe classic, they are versatile, understated and polished -- wear them with tailored separates or dresses.

name: Striped Tie-Around Pointed Kitten Heels
description: These heels feature white-and-blue striped uppers, tie-around ankle straps, covered pointed toes and low kitten heels for a subtle lift. Wear them to add visual interest to both workday and weekend ensembles.

name: Crystal Pointed Slingback Pumps
description: Embellished with eye-catching crystals, these pointed-toe slingback pumps stand out for all the right reasons. Adjustable buckled slingback straps ensure a secure, customised fit for comfortable all-day wear despite their tall stiletto heels.

name: Clementine Double-Strap Slingback Mary Jane Pumps
description: Eye-catching in red, this pair of Mary Janes pumps definitely makes a style statement. Thanks to their bright and glossy finish, they will add a pop of colour to any look and make it stand out. The distinctive double-strapped design adds flair to the simple silhouette while 4cm block heels offer a flattering and comfortable stature boost. Style them with white socks for a preppy vibe.

name: Curtis Metallic Slingback Kitten Heels
description: Add a bold pop to your outfit with these slingback pumps. Featuring a high-shine mirrored finish and sharp pointed toes, they are sleek and striking in all the right ways. Kitten heels offer a flattering lift to your frame while still being wearable enough for those busy on-the-go days. Wear these with a monochromatic outfit to let them shine, or match it to other metallic pieces for a standout look.

name: Bow Slingback Mary Jane Pumps
description: Bows can spruce up your outfits in a subtle way. The classic slingback silhouette looks especially pristine in white and will lend your ensembles a timeless charm. Decorated with bows on the sides, they are a dainty pair to wear with skirts and dresses.

name: Yvette Mary Jane Slingback Pumps
description: Featuring an ever-classic pointed-toe design, the elongated silhouette is certain to add instant polish to any look. In all-black, they will do well to complement any outfit of your choice, be it the finishing touch to your graduation gown or a work interview. Set on sturdy block heels, these shoes offer steady strides even as you walk in them for long hours. Plus points for the slingback straps that offer a secure fit.

name: Jagger Knee-High Loafer-Boots
description: These Jagger knee-high boots in black feature softly rounded toes, knee-high shafts and a hybrid loafer design. Wear them with artfully layered fall-winter looks -- they will keep you warm and looking chic.

name: Pointed Stiletto Ankle Boots
description: These ankle boots in black feature pointed toes, back zips, stiletto heels and narrow shafts. Wear them with draped or voluminous clothes to create a balanced look consisting of sharp lines and soft layers.

name: Square-Toe Knee-High Boots
description: These knee-high boots in black feature side zips, square toes and block heels. Pair them with blazers and satin skirts for a sophisticated aesthetic that is suitable for both the office and after-hours gatherings.

name: Patent Metallic-Buckle Pointed Pumps
description: These pumps in burgundy feature a patent finish, covered pointed toes, slender stiletto heels and polished metallic accents on the front. Let them complete your evening ensemble with a touch of edgy glamour.

name: Caged Flat Espadrilles
description: These flat espadrilles in maroon feature a caged design, ruched elasticised heels, shiny round buckles and flat espadrille soles. Let them add rich colour to your favourite warm-weather casual ensembles.

name: Striped Mary Jane Espadrille Mules
description: These espadrille mules in dark blue feature a striped design, espadrille soles, adjustable straps across the insteps, covered round toes and an easy-wearing open backs. They are the perfect slip-on shoes for the weekends and vacations.

name: Buckled Espadrille Sandals
description: White sandals are a must-have for summer -- your warm-season shoe collection would not be complete without this pair of espadrille sandals in chic cream. This slip-on pair is the perfect casual shoes for laid-back vacation days by the beach. The simple straps across the vamps are complemented by shiny gold-toned buckles. Standing on thick braided-rope soles, these shoes will look perfect with a white summer dress or classic denim cut-offs.

name: Georgie Linen Metal-Ball Heeled Sandals
description: These Georgie sandals in chalk are made with linen and feature polished metal-ball embellishments, rounded square toes and low block heels that make them comfortable enough for all-day wear. Wear them with structured layers to build a weekday look that stands out.

name: Georgie Bead Pointed Mules
description: These Georgie mules in black feature knotted straps with colourful bead embellishments, covered pointed toes, chunky block heels and a slip-on design. Pair them with tailored separates and sleek midi dresses for a refined finish.

name: Cut-Out Block-Heel Mules
description: These mules in white feature wide straps with cut-out details, open round toes and low chunky block heels that make them suitable for all-day wear. Wear them to ground a date-night look with clean lines and classic design.

name: Lando Faux Suede Heeled Mules
description: These Lando heeled mules in beige are made with faux suede and feature pointed toes, metallic buckles and trapeze block heels. Style them with tailored trousers or flowy dresses for a chic look that transitions effortlessly from day to evening.

name: Sonali Bow Strawberry-Heel Mules
description: These Sonali mules in black feature slim strappy uppers adorned with dainty bows, open toes and whimsical strawberry-shaped heels. Wear them to bring a touch of whimsy to your date night looks.

name: Satin Twisted-Strap Pointed Mules
description: These flat mules in light pink are made with satin and feature asymmetrical twisted straps, sleek pointed toes and a minimalist design. Use them to refine workwear outfits with luxurious texture, clean lines and soft colour.

name: Arden Pointed Wavy Heeled Mules
description: These light-pink Arden mules feature asymmetrical wavy straps, mid heels and sleek pointed toes. They will add a touch of refined femininity when paired with monochrome tailored workwear ensembles.

name: Tapered Square-Toe Heeled Mules
description: These mules in black feature a tapered square-toe design, thin buckled straps across the vamps, and distinctive flared stiletto heels. They will refine your weekday ensembles with their clean lines and sophisticated details.

name: Glittered Mesh Heeled Mules
description: These mules in black are made with glittered mesh and feature wide-strap uppers, open square toes, and mid stiletto heels. Let them polish up jersey separates and lightweight dresses for relaxed-chic weekend edits.

name: Glittered Mesh Bow Kitten Heels
description: These mules in pink are made with glittered mesh and feature dainty bows, sleek pointed toes, and very low kitten heels. Use them to add eye-catching sparkle and feminine charm to both your workday and weekend ensembles.

name: Strappy Heeled Sandals
description: These sandals in black feature strappy crossover uppers, slender stiletto heels, and neat square toes. Wear them with a softly draped evening dress to look effortlessly poised, polished and glamorous.

name: Faux Suede Metallic-Bar Loafer Mules
description: These loafer mules in beige are made with faux suede and feature sleek metallic-bar embellishments, elegant almond toes, and refined stitch-trim detailing. Pair them with tailored trousers for a sophisticated smart-casual look.

name: Aelin Kitten-Heel Mules
description: These Aelin mules in espresso brown feature a minimalist single-strap design, distinctive metallic buckles, stylish square toes, and dainty kitten heels. Wear them to bring warmth and polish to your weekend edits.

name: Dylan Penny Loafer Mules
description: These Dylan loafer mules in black feature ruched detailing, classic penny straps, almond toes and a slip-on design. Wear them to add subtle sophistication to your dressed-down workday and weekend looks.

name: Ivette Faux Suede Woven Heeled Mules
description: These Ivette heeled mules in burgundy are made with faux suede and feature woven uppers, open square toes and sturdy block heels. Let them ground minimalist dresses to create outfits that are versatile enough to suit a range of occasions.

name: Georgina Crossover Blade-Heel Mules
description: These Georgina mules in black feature crossover straps, round toes and blade heels. Wear them with midi pencil skirts and tucked blouses to establish a quietly assured look ideal for workplace settings.

name: Susie Satin Kitten-Heel Mules
description: These Susie mules in mauve are made with satin and feature a minimalist design, low kitten heels and stylish square toes. Let them complement neutral layers with a touch of understated feminine charm.

name: Arden Wavy Strap Mules
description: Liven up your look with these modern mules. The wavy strap design will earn you a few double takes, whilst the chalk white colour keeps it clean and classy. Set on a 4cm cylindrical heel, these contemporary shoes are sure to elevate your weekday and weekend ensembles. For an effortlessly chic look, style them with a puff sleeve blouse, blue jeans, and a double handle tote bag.

name: Marley Metallic-Accent Loafers
description: In beautiful burgundy, these Marley loafers will be a great addition to your shoe collection. The sleek loafer silhouette is always a classic, while the metallic accents add a hint of shine that elevates the look. Perfect for matching with both tailored corporate looks and cute babydoll dresse

name: Metallic Knot-Bar Loafers
description: Let your chunky loafers take a backseat in favour of these sleek and sophisticated almond-toe loafers. Simple in design, the gold-tone metallic knot accents stand out beautifully against the clean black uppers, adding just the right amount of shine to elevate your everyday look.

name: Kaiya Penny Loafers
description: Tired of your usual black shoes? Reach for these Kaiya penny loafers in dark brown instead. Just as elegant and versatile, they feature an effortless slip-on style, decorative slotted leather strips across the vamps and platform soles that provide a slight lift while remaining comfortable for everyday wear. The simplicity of these shoes imbues them with refined sophistication, making them versatile enough to complement anything in your wardrobe.

name: Strappy Ridged-Sole Flatform Sandals
description: These flatform sandals in chalk feature strappy uppers, open round toes and thick ridged soles. Wear them with your favourite casual basics on off-duty days for both style and comfort.

name: Strappy Tubular Wedge Sandals
description: A modern take on strappy sandals, this pair is casually sophisticated. Crossover tubular straps lend tactility to the classic open-toed design, while toe rings add a charming touch. In versatile black, these sleek sandals will be a breeze to style with different aesthetics and ensembles. Set on wedge soles that will boost your stature, these distinctive sandals balance wearability with effortless style.

name: Bow Slingback Thong Sandals
description: These thong sandals in white feature a minimalist thong silhouette, V-strap uppers, dainty bows, open toes, elasticised slingback straps and very low block heels. Wear them to complement satin dresses and softly layered weekend looks.

name: Kitten-Heel Thong Sandals
description: These heeled thong sandals in chalk feature open square toes, a minimalist design and trapeze kitten heels. They will go with everything in your wardrobe, from colourful spring-summer dresses to dark monochromatic ensembles.

name: Striped Bow Slide Sandals
description: These slide sandals in grey feature a single strap design with eye-catching striped bows, open round toes and barely there flat soles. Pair them with casual basics to create a playful and lively off-duty look.

name: Pointed Peep-Toe Stiletto Sandals
description: These heeled sandals in red feature pointed fronts, peep-toe details, slender ankle straps and sharp stiletto heels. Match them to evening looks in deep tones for a bold yet timelessly elegant aesthetic.

name: Leather Beaded Thong Kitten Heels
description: These heeled sandals in chalk are made with genuine leather and feature beaded straps atop the slender V-straps, low kitten heels, open round toes. Use them to add a playful and eye-catching touch to your summer outfits.

name: Striped Square-Toe Slide Sandals
description: These slide sandals in yellow feature a striped design, wide single-straps, open square toes, cushioned footbeds, thin flat soles and logo-engraved metal bars. They are perfect for showing off your pedicure during the warmer months.

name: Georgie Bead Strappy Sandals
description: These Georgie sandals in black feature a knotted strappy design, colourful bead embellishments, slim adjustable slingback straps, open round toes and flat soles for all-day comfort. Pair them with minimalist, flowy summer dresses to keep your warm-weather look effortless and elegant.

name: Arden Wavy Toe-Ring Sandals
description: These Arden sandals in mint green feature wavy strappy uppers, toe rings, slender back straps, open round toes and low flat soles. Wear them on casual days to add a soft pop of colour to fuss-free off-duty looks.

name: Cut-Out Slide Sandals
description: These slide sandals in maroon feature wide straps with an intricate cut-out pattern, open square toes, soft cushioned footbeds and barely-there soles. Let them elevate your casual outfits with rich colour and striking details.

name: Studded Buckled Slide Sandals
description: These slide sandals in beige are made with faux nubuck leather and feature a buckled single-strap design embellished with gold studs, open square toes and flat soles. Let them enhance relaxed ensembles with edgy elegance.

name: V-Strap Thong Sandals
description: These thong sandals in white feature a simple, minimalist design, slim v-strap uppers, flat cushioned footbeds and open round toes. Let them complete your casual warm-weather outfits with effortless style.

name: Sonali Bow Heeled Thong Sandals
description: These Sonali heeled thong sandals in burgundy feature kitten heels, open round toes and dainty bow details. Style them with loose blouses and fluid trousers for a refined and feminine weekday look.

name: Ruched-Strap Slide Sandals
description: These slide sandals in white feature shimmery ruched straps, open round toes and an asymmetrical double-strap design. Match them with casual separates to add subtle sheen to create relaxed yet polished outfits.

name: Woven Tie-Around Net Sandals
description: These woven sandals in black feature netted uppers, tie-around ankle straps, polisehd square toes and comfortable flat soles. Let them bring stylish definition to relaxed jersey pieces and well-worn denim.
